capabilities: Select sections, lines, and internal links via hotkeys
Navigate the cursor to next/previous headings of any level
Move entire sections up or down
Paste clipboard content as a code block with automatic language detection
Copy content from multiple files at once via context menu or tag-based selection
extras: Installation is documented only through BRAT, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: adds new useful hotkeys for text editing, text selection, navigation and several additional features
motivation: The author built it to add features he felt would be useful for his daily Obsidian usage, and hopes it helps others.
problem: Obsidian lacks built-in hotkeys for fine-grained text selection, section-level editing, and heading navigation that power users need for daily editing.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT Plugin from Obsidian Community Plugins or from the GitHub repository.

summary: Hotkey addon that adds commands for section/line/link selection, heading navigation, section moving, and paste-as-code-block with language detection.
